title: System monitor widget adds graphs for static data strings
line: In the System Monitor widget's Grid style, text sensors like the operating system name or Plasma version are shown as plain text instead of an empty graph.
explanation: The Grid face gives every sensor its own cell and loads the configured chart face (line chart by default) in each one, whatever the sensor holds, so text sensors such as Operating System Name or KDE Plasma Version showed an empty chart with a 0..0 axis. Sensors can declare their value type, but the osinfo plugin in ksystemstats never set one, so the client had no way to tell they are text. The osinfo plugin now marks its text sensors (kernel, OS, hostname, logo, URL, Qt/Frameworks/Plasma version, window system) as strings, like the cpu plugin already does for CPU names. The Grid face reads each sensor's type from one SensorDataModel for the whole grid, creates its cells once the metadata is in, and gives string sensors the text-only face; SensorDataModel no longer reports ready before its QML component is complete, so cells are not first built with a chart and then rebuilt.

commits.message:
plugins/osinfo: mark text sensors as strings

The osinfo plugin set no variant type on its sensors, so clients could
not tell that names and versions are text and the System Monitor Grid
face drew empty charts for them. They are now typed as strings.

BUG: 521257

faces/grid: show text sensors without a chart

The Grid face used the chart face for every sensor, so text sensors got
an empty chart. Cells now wait for the sensor metadata and use the text
face for strings, and SensorDataModel is not ready until QML sets it up.

BUG: 521257

patches.diff:
From 6cb96994d984a7bb60413f16e524c94e8396da1f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 23:43:34 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] plugins/osinfo: mark text sensors as strings

The osinfo plugin set no variant type on its sensors, so clients could
not tell that names and versions are text and the System Monitor Grid
face drew empty charts for them. They are now typed as strings.

BUG: 521257
---
 plugins/osinfo/osinfo.cpp | 16 ++++++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 16 insertions(+)

diff --git a/plugins/osinfo/osinfo.cpp b/plugins/osinfo/osinfo.cpp
index 97672c2..192a5f4 100644
--- a/plugins/osinfo/osinfo.cpp
+++ b/plugins/osinfo/osinfo.cpp
@@ -131,6 +131,22 @@ OSInfoPrivate::OSInfoPrivate(OSInfoPlugin *qq)
     kfVersionProperty = new KSysGuard::SensorProperty(QStringLiteral("kfVersion"), i18nc("@title", "KDE Frameworks Version"), plasmaObject);
     plasmaVersionProperty = new KSysGuard::SensorProperty(QStringLiteral("plasmaVersion"), i18nc("@title", "KDE Plasma Version"), plasmaObject);
     windowSystemProperty = new KSysGuard::SensorProperty(QStringLiteral("windowsystem"), i18nc("@title", "Window System"), plasmaObject);
+
+    for (auto property : {kernelNameProperty,
+                          kernelVersionProperty,
+                          kernelPrettyNameProperty,
+                          hostnameProperty,
+                          osNameProperty,
+                          osVersionProperty,
+                          osPrettyNameProperty,
+                          osLogoProperty,
+                          osUrlProperty,
+                          qtVersionProperty,
+                          kfVersionProperty,
+                          plasmaVersionProperty,
+                          windowSystemProperty}) {
+        property->setVariantType(QVariant::String);
+    }
 }
 
 OSInfoPlugin::~OSInfoPlugin() = default;
-- 
2.53.0

Same widget and sensors with the fix: both are shown as text, no charts
Mixed grid on pure master: OS name and CPU name (already typed as a string by ksystemstats) both get empty charts
Same mixed grid with the fix: the two text sensors are text only, CPU usage and memory keep their live line charts
